description: Posted Street Sweeping Routes is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Motor sweeping program: route s, boundaries and times for posted routes only. Maps are available as downloadable PDFs under the Attachments section of the About tab. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category City Infrastructure & Service Requests. Its tags are street, sweeping, cd, boundaries, area. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: Bureau of Street Services. The portal shows 2014-05-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
